Class PlayerStats

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.PlayerStats
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerStats extends Object implements Serializable
Mutable bag of per-player gameplay state owned by a Player. Holds the resources (food, victory points), the running counters fed by buildings and events (shamanStars, feedingSale, buildingSale, builderPoints), the set of unique inventions discovered, and the lists of CharacterCards and BuildingCards the player has accumulated.

Mutators are exposed as additive add* helpers rather than plain setters, since the gameplay rules only ever increment these counters.
